research.name: ShaderToy unofficial plugin
research.note: Browser extension that adds iTime and iMouse sliders, GPU render timers, a vec3 color picker and export to the Shadertoy editor.

effects: iTime scrub slider with start/end range and loop toggle under the Shadertoy canvas
four sliders that simulate the iMouse.xyzw uniform
per-pass GPU render time overlay on the canvas (Image / Buffer A in ms)
inline color picker opened from a vec3 literal in the GLSL editor
